description.en: When a world-weary bartender saves a wooden cat doll from the rain one fateful night, he gets more than he ever bargained for….the cat talks and serves a little boy with lavender hair and monstrously sharp teeth. Say hello to Vry.

Shin Gyu Yun is the heir of the Shin Oong Group and the self-proclaimed prince of Korea's economy. However, he has a secret. Since his father left them before Shin was born, he can't help but clean things due to his past of helping out his mother with the chores. It wasn't until that Shin's mother died in an accident that he came to know his scheming step-sisters by moving into his father's estate. The step-sisters conspire to make him lose his position… but could that have made him fall in love with a low-class girl?
description.ru: Шин Гуй Юнь — наследник Шин Оонг Групп и самозванный принц экономики Кореи. Однако у него есть тайна. Поскольку его отец оставил их прежде, чем Шин родился, он только и делает, что убирается, чтобы помочь одинокой матери. Мать Шина умерла в результате несчастного случая, и он познакомился со своими сводными сестрами, когда переехал к своему отцу. Сводные сестры строят коварные планы, чтобы он потерял свое состояние... но именно это, возможно, заставило его влюбиться в девушку низшего класса?

description.en:
For Grand Duke Heverus, marriage was nothing more than a means to an end. His union with Leticia, an adopted daughter of a count’s family, began just as simply, a one year contractual marriage. But the Grand Duke slowly grew attached to Leticia, and just as he was about to confess his feelings after returning from the battlefield, he was struck with shock. 

Leticia had already died from a terminal illness. 

Regretting his own indifference, he risked his life and used the power of ancient magic to turn back time. This time, he is determined to save Leticia, to grant her happiness, and so he proposes the contractual marriage once more. 

But there’s a problem. 

Merely watching her isn’t enough. He wants her. Forever.

하지만 대공은 천천히 리트리샤에게 스며들었고

자신의 무심함을 후회하며 목숨을 담보로 고대마법의 힘을 빌려 회귀한 그. 

이번에야말로 반드시 리트리샤를 살리기 위해, 
그녀의 행복을 빌어주기 위해, 
그렇게 시간을 돌려 다시 계약 결혼을 제안하는데,

A boy with a Resurrection Heart. Not even hundreds of deaths could kill him. Now, Jio sets his sights on the research lab that suppressed him and his friends their entire lives.

Having gained independence from Revro, the Earth secretly trains an army of boys. Jino and Izare are abandoned to the camp, and Izare silently sacrifices himself to keep his promise to Maria that he'd look after Jino. But Jino escapes the soul-killing cruelty of the camp. With Jino in his heart, Izare remains to become an ultimate weapon. The boys' lives, and the secrets of the mysterious Maria, gradually unravel. For Earth, can peace and utopia be won?

description.de: Nach einem schrecklichen Unfall erwacht Lucette als junges Mädchen in einem abgelegenen Dorf des Kaiserreichs Vladin – einem Ort, den sie eigentlich nur aus einer extrem brutalen Webnovel kennt. Ohne einen Weg, in ihre eigene Welt zurückzugelangen, beschließt Lucette, das Beste daraus zu machen und ihr Leben fernab der gefährlichen Hauptstadt zu genießen. Das ist zumindest der Plan, bis sie sich mit dem brillanten, aber mysteriösen Jungen namens Lev anfreundet. Wird Lucettes Leben weiterhin so friedlich bleiben? Was wird passieren, wenn ihre stetig wachsende Freundschaft ein lebensbedrohliches Geheimnis offenbart?
description.en:
Before her accident, Lucette was a young woman living in modern-day Korea. So why did she wake up in the body of a little girl living in the remote outskirts of the Vladin Empire? That was the setting of the ultra-violent webnovel she was reading when she was hit by a truck! 

But since things have come to this, Lucette might as well get her hustle on, far away from the dangerous capital. At least, that's what she thought before befriending a brilliant but mysterious boy named Lev. 

What will happen as their growing bond unveils a life-threatening secret?
description.fr: Avant son accident, Lucette était une jeune coréenne des temps modernes, alors quelle n’est pas sa surprise lorsqu'elle se réveille dans le corps d'une petite fille vivant dans les contrées reculées de l'Empire de Vladin, l'univers du web novel ultra-violent qu'elle était en train de lire au moment où elle s’est fait percuter par un camion ! Mais puisqu'elle en est là, Lucette est bien décidée à faire tout son possible pour se contruire une vie, loin de la dangereuse capitale. Enfin, c'était son projet… jusqu'à ce qu’elle se lie d'amitié avec un garçon brillant mais mystérieux nommé Lev. Alors que leur lien grandissant renferme un secret qui pourrait leur coûter la vie, qu’adviendra-t-il d’eux?
description.id: Saya dirasuki oleh novel miskin berusia 19 tahun di mana seorang tiran menjadi gila dan membunuh semua karakternya. Masalahnya, kamu hanya melihat adegannya sekilas dan tidak mengetahui cerita lengkapnya! Bagaimanapun, hanya ada satu orang yang harus dihindari. Seorang kaisar yang seleranya pas. Tapi apakah saya, seorang rakyat jelata, akan bertemu dengan kaisar? Tinggal di desa di ujung benua yang jauh dari istana kekaisaran, saya hanya punya satu minat! “Saya Lucete. “Kamu bisa memanggilku Luce.” "saya juga… … “Panggil aku Lev.” Lev, seorang anak laki-laki misterius yang suatu hari tiba-tiba muncul di kota. “Apa yang sebenarnya akan kamu lakukan tanpa aku?” "Aku tahu. "Bagaimana saya bisa hidup tanpa mu?" Saya khawatir karena dia begitu baik dan polos, saya harus menjaganya dan melindunginya! … … Saya pikir begitu. “… … “Tempat lain boleh-boleh saja, tapi tolong jangan datang ke lantai dua.” "Silakan. “Kamu tidak boleh meminum ini.” "Tidak ada apa-apa." Mengapa kamu memiliki begitu banyak rahasia? “Laporkan setiap menit siapa yang ditemui Lucete, apa yang dia lakukan, dan apa yang dia tertawakan.” Temanku menghilang beberapa saat dan kembali lagi, membuatku semakin curiga. “Sudah kubilang, Luce. “Aku tidak bisa hidup tanpamu.” Siapa kamu?

description.pl: Przed wypadkiem Lucette była młodą kobietą mieszkającą we współczesnej Korei. Dlaczego więc obudziła się w ciele małej dziewczynki mieszkającej na odległych obrzeżach Imperium Vladin? To właśnie tam rozgrywała się akcja ultrabrutalnej powieści internetowej, którą czytała, gdy potrąciła ją ciężarówka! Ale skoro doszło do tego, Lucette równie dobrze może żyć swoim życiem, z dala od niebezpiecznej stolicy. Przynajmniej tak myślała, zanim zaprzyjaźniła się z błyskotliwym, ale tajemniczym chłopcem o imieniu Levi. Co się stanie, gdy ich rozwijająca się więź ujawni zagrażający życiu sekret?
description.ru:
Я попала в ужасающую новеллу R-19, в которой тиран сошёл с ума и убил всех персонажей этой истории.

Проблема в том, что я только смотрела на сцены и не знала их содержания должным образом!

В любом случае, есть только один человек, которого следует избегать, и это не кто иной, как император.

Но как у простолюдинки, будет ли у меня вообще шанс встретиться с ним?

Живя в деревне на дальнем конце континента, которая была очень далека от императорского дворца, у меня есть только один интерес!

— Я Люсетт. Но ты можешь звать меня Люси.

— Я… Рев.

Однажды в деревне внезапно появился таинственный мальчик по имени Рев.

— В самом деле, что ты собираешься делать без меня?

Да, как я могу жить без тебя?

Я волнуюсь, потому что он такой добрый и наивный, поэтому я должна заботиться о нём и защищать!

……Вот что я думала.

— …Всё в порядке, но тебе не следует подниматься на второй этаж.

— Пожалуйста, ты не должна это пить.

— Это пустяки.

Почему у тебя так много секретов?

— Немедленно сообщайте, с кем она встречается, что делает и кому улыбается.

Мой друг, который исчез на некоторое время, вернулся ещё более подозрительным.

— Я же говорил тебе, Люси. Я не могу жить без тебя.

Да кто ты такой!?

description.en: In the distant future, people live in abundance in the Retreats, a so-called Paradise on Earth. This prosperity is made possible at the expense of an impoverished underclass in the surrounding slums of Brine, who must either serve the citizens of the Retreats or fight in the dreaded Battlegrounds for a shot at becoming a Retreats citizen. For Brine resident John Canty, whose father and grandfather died in the Battlegrounds, the desire to rise to the Retreats seems like a hopeless pipedream. All that changes when his new job takes him into the Retreats and he encounters Edward, a boy who looks identical to his own son Gable…

Discovering that the character is a YouTuber named 'Nyami,' Dajeong decides to support her dad's hobby. However, she soon realizes that the YouTuber character, which she thought was just a hobby, is being controlled directly by her dad...

An arranged marriage tied her to a child groom eight years younger.

A sudden accident ends everything—until she opens her eyes in a new body. Determined to erase the past and start over, she keeps her distance… until a chance encounter with the former husband, now a grown man acting strangely.

“I never forgot you. Not for a single moment.”

Ten years on, he still hasn’t let go.

And the now-older ex warns, “Don’t forget that I’m watching you.”

Her fresh start is suddenly under suspicion.

Determinada a apagar o passado e recomeçar, ela mantém distância... até um encontro casual com o ex-marido, agora um homem adulto agindo de forma estranha. "Eu nunca te esqueci. Nem por um instante." description.en:
"A slave who knows things only a noble would… Who is this girl, really?"

Lilliette, once the Empress of the vast Pardinas Empire, was killed by her lover and found herself reincarnated in the body of a nameless slave girl, roughly 17 years in the past. Choosing death over a life of pain, Lilliette provokes a noble and collapses. When she opens her eyes again, standing before her is none other than Slarhan Bentiac, her greatest political rival in her previous life. Now bound as a slave to the same capable man he was then, Lilliette begins a strange new life. 

But… why is this man unexpectedly kind and considerate to me? 

Determined, Lilliette resolves to use the knowledge from her past to help Slarhan become king for the sake of the empire and to take revenge on the lover who betrayed and killed her: Clid.

이에 릴리에트는 제국을 위해 자신이 아는 정보들로 슬라르한을 왕으로 만들고, 전생에 자신을 죽인 정인 ‘클리드’에게도 복수하기로 다짐하는데…

Лилиет, бывшая императрица великой империи Пардинас, погибла от руки своего возлюбленного и перенеслась в прошлое на 17 лет назад, где очнулась в теле рабыни.

Лилиет, которая скорее предпочтёт спровоцировать дворян и умереть, чем жить в боли, некоторок время спустя, приходит в себя, и перед ней оказывается её лейший враг из прошлой жизни, Слархан Бентиак.
Тогда и сейчас я живу как рабыня этого человека, который был способен...
Этот мужчина тайно заботится обо мне и хорошо ко мне относится... ?

Итак, Лилиет клянется использовать известную ей информацию, чтобы сделать Слархана главой империи и отомстить своему возлюбленному Клиду, который убил её в прошлой жизни...

Сох, которая с юных лет всегда страстно увлекалась пением, становится стажером в большой развлекательной компании! Но по мере взросления ее голос становится хриплым, а тело - широким. Кажется, она никуда не денется, и ее доводит до предела, когда к их женской группе присоединяется новая участница, Сена. Несмотря на все свои усилия, она решает отказаться от своей мечты стать звездой к-поп, потеряв всякую надежду когда-либо добиться успеха. Но затем она узнает, что Юджин, мальчик-идол, на которого она всегда равнялась, проводит прослушивания для новых участников своего бойз-бенда. Благодаря своей мальчишеской внешности и голосу она решила, что это ее выстрел. Она не теряет времени зря, одалживает удостоверение своего брата-близнеца и выбегает на живые прослушивания! That too, on the mountain behind my house. Seeing him like a mountain animal, Sena vowed never to climb a mountain again. After finally returning home and getting back to her daily life, Sena notices a familiar face. It was none other than that person back then... No wait, wasn’t he a ‘natural person’? I understand, so please don’t pretend to know me, please!

description.ko:
전교생에게 사랑받는 선도부장 구소정. 담배 단속을 돌던 중 화장실에서 꿈에 그리던 이상형을 만난다.
그를 다시 만나기 위해 화장실을 전전하던 소정은 마침내 이상형과 재회하지만,
실수로 그의 좋지 않은 곳(?)을 만지고 마는데..!
오해에서 고백까지, 좌충우돌 러브 코미디!
description.pt-br: Goo Jeong é o líder de equipe de liderança da escola e ele é amado por todos os alunos. Durante a repressão ao cigarro, em uma investigação rotineira ele acaba encontrando o seu tipo ideal no banheiro. Ao tentar encontrá-lo de novo nos banheiros um incidente acaba acontecendo, fazendo com que ambos se conheçam. De um mal-entendido para uma confissão cheia de comédia. !! Eu acidentalmente toquei...... Leiam para descobrir está maravilhosa historia!!

description.en: "From the beginning, I shouldn't have gotten involved." Hyuk, feeling lonely, starts using anonymous chat rooms to alleviate his loneliness, even going as far as attending gatherings with strangers. However, one day, news breaks that one of the people who attended the gathering was murdered. As Hyuk reunites with those who were present at the gathering on the same day, he begins to feel suspicious...

One day, Seok-woo, a third-year photography student, receives an offer from a famous magazine.

His heart races with excitement… but the person he’s recently been seeing around might just be a ghost?!
To decide whether to shoot Seok-woo — someone mysteriously tied to a strange photo — the editor decides to hold an open casting.

Then, an odd and unpredictable applicant shows up.

“You want to model for the ‘Nameless’ photo?”

A mysterious and charming freshman model slowly begins entering Seok-woo’s world…

❝Can Seok-woo capture that ‘nameless’ shot and make his debut through the magazine?❞

A heartwarming and romantic journey begins!
A story about a boy who by chance discovers a suspicious aquarium where he meets the odd but lovable and sincere, yet unpredictable people.

Cute and charming, but not so bright, little Rika is training to become a real wizard. The first step is to find a magic staff. That can’t be too hard, can it? As Rika and Eugen journey deep into the forest in search of this wonderful staff, Rika gets lost encounters the dark sorcerer who kidnapped the princess! Will Rika be able to free the princess and become a real wizard?

On one stormy night, Lee Na somehow bumps into one of them and cant forget him ever since then. Is this the beginning of love?

description.ko:
언제까지 썸만 탈꺼야? 이제 연애할 때도 됐잖아!

description.en:
A young master with love troubles.  
A short story with an unexpected ending!

A very poor high school girl finds a very rare breed of dog on her way home. Grateful for her help, the dog's owner gives her a huge house as an award, but, in order to have it, she must continue to take care of Gold, the dog that she found. Will the money be worth it?

Jung Dan Bi accidentally collides into top model Jung Ee Dun, plastering a piece of her toast onto his shirt. Not having enough time to even take the blame she ran off telling him to…

Claycie, who must marry to inherit her fortune, repeatedly loses her chance at romance due to the interference of her niece, Meren, who is nearly the same age. Eventually, Claycie meets a man like a stroke of fate and marries him after finding true love. However, during their happy newlywed life, a jealous Meren travels back in time. In this new life, Meren goes as far as stealing Claycie's husband. Claycie, who had always been pushed around by Meren, declares that if Meren steals her husband, she will steal Meren's husband in return!

Having swapped husbands after the regression, a bitter love square begins, fueled by sharp psychological warfare between an aunt and niece who know each other all too well.
description.fr:
Pour toucher son héritage, Claicy n'a pas le choix : elle doit se marier. Malheureusement, sa nièce Meren, qui a presque le même âge qu’elle, sabote systématiquement toutes ses chances de trouver l'amour. Après bien des épreuves, Claicy finit par rencontrer l’homme de sa vie et l'épouse enfin.

Mais leur bonheur est de courte durée. Consumée par la jalousie, Meren remonte le temps pour lui voler son mari dans cette nouvelle vie. Poussée à bout, Claicy ne compte plus se laisser faire : si sa nièce lui prend son époux, elle lui prendra le sien en retour ! Une guerre psychologique sans merci commence entre tante et nièce, où les sentiments s'entremêlent et se brisent.

description.en:
When Seongho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. 

Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seongho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom. 

But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters…

Evan Pryce is a celebrated New York Times reporter, and true to his prominent journalistic lineage, he has just published an exclusive scoop that is brilliant enough to be considered for the Pulitzer Prize. Unfortunately, this also makes him easy prey to the many enemies he has made throughout his career. 

Instead of going in hiding, however, Evan decides to hole up at his press office - not the safest place for a man in Evan's situation. Unwilling to have his star reporter remain so vulnerable to attack, the Editor-in-Chief orders Evan to cover an out-of-state story: "real" ghost sightings in a secluded village in the countryside—an article too absurd to be handled by the New York Times. For lack of a better thing to do, Evan decides to follow his editor's orders and drives across the Midwestern desert searching for a town nobody seems to have heard of. 

After ten days of driving by sleepy rural villages with zero results, our lost and exhausted New Yorker is just about ready to give up. But then suddenly, a road sign pointing to "Roureville" catches his eye, and he heaves a sigh of relief. Little does he know that the end of his long road trip is just the beginning of an incredible tale.
description.ru: Эван Прайс - блестящий журналист из Нью-Йорк Тамс. После очередной сенсационной статьи, его жизнь оказывается под угрозой и он решает просто таки поселиться в офисе. Такой расклад не устраивает его редактор (как впрочем и всех остальных, ибо характерец у Эвана не сахар) и он отсылает его в маленький и никому не известный городок Рурвилль, в котором якобы появился призрак. Эван соглашается, чтобы немного убить время, но явно недооценивает происходящего...

description.ko:
전역 하루를 앞둔 말년 병장 고우리.

하지만 북한에서 넘어온 화학 무기로 인해 
군부대는 좀비 바이러스로 감염된다.

겨우 위기의 순간을 모면하고 
중대원들과 고우리는 생존하게 된다.

하지만 막사는 좀비들로 인해 포위 당한 상태였고 
외부하고는 연락도 안 되는 상황.

막사 내 생존자는 몸이 무거운 중대장 1명과 39명의 병사.
그렇게 그들의 끝나지 않는 또 다른 군 생활이 시작된다.

description.en:
I was reborn as Heraise Lorca, the cherished daughter of a viscount and nothing more than an extra in a novel — or so I thought. 

Life was calm until my father told me to become the playmate of Zenon Lianeric, heir to the house we serve. At first, I thought I would just keep him company, but no, he’s a complete lunatic who plays with magic and uses his friends as toys! 

Then I found out that he’s terminally ill — and if I can’t save him, I might not survive either!
description.ko:
“헤레이스, 도련님의 놀이 친구가 되어주렴.”
부잣집 자작가의 막내딸로 빙의해 평생 놀고먹을 줄 알았다.
리어네릭 공작가 가신인 아버지의 부탁을 듣기 전까지는.

끝까지 살아남으면 보석 상자를 줄게."
마나를 이용해 친구들을 공중에 매달아 괴롭히다니,
사람을 장난감 취급하는 예의 없는 녀석이잖아!
게다가 마나를 사용할 때마다 수명이 깎이는 시한부라고?

“네가 뭔데 날 판단하지?”
제논 리어네릭, 너의 버릇을 단단히 고쳐 주겠어!

= = =

그렇게 놀이 친구 역할을 착실히 했을 뿐인데….
“너는 나랑 친해진 것 같아?”
“계속 출 거면, 지금부터는 나랑 춰.”
“…갈 땐 가더라도 몸은 말리고 가.”

제논이 내게 집착하기 시작했다.
description.ru:
Она стала спутницей слабого молодого господина, чья продолжительность жизни сокращалась каждый раз, когда он использовал ману.
Хотя молодой герцог обладал более сильной маной, чем предыдущие герцоги, все думали, что он умрет, не достигнув совершеннолетия.
"Молодой господин, это моя дочь, Элоиза".
"..."
"Элоиза, почему ты не приветствуешь меня?"
Зенон, вспыльчивый молодой господин, который долгое время оставался без внимания. Ее отец, сказал, что нужно сблизиться с этим молодым мастером. Хоть ей это не нравилось, она общалась с ним, так как ей было жаль его.

description.en: In a future where the world has been devastated by a deadly gas called Izpo, Minhui and his friends find themselves embroiled in a thick conspiracy — where the stakes are high, and bets are made with one’s life. Only the Memorial Chips guard humanity against the lethal gas that permeates the atmosphere. But are these electronic securities truly built to guard us — or watch us? Follow Minhui as he examines what reality is, and comes face-to-face with the truth that will change him forever.
description.ko:
평범한 일상을 보내고 있던 고등학생 '민희'는 예전부터 좋아하던 친구에게 고백을 계획한다.
그러나 고백 전날, '그 애'와 관련된 불길한 꿈을 꾸게 되고 현실에서 '그 애'와 관련된 모든 것이 사라지고 만다.
모든 것이 혼란스러운 민희는 '그 애'를 찾기 시작하는데..

description.en:
Rose falls asleep at home and nearly faints when she wakes up at the palace in the arms of Emperor Lukewarell. Despite her uncanny resemblance to his beloved concubine, Agnes, Rose manages to convince Lukewarell that she is an ordinary tutor with no relation.

However, she must help him find the missing Agnes by masquerading as the concubine and feeling out the suspicious people around her. But the more Rose learns about Agnes complicated relationships, the less she understands who this mysterious woman was. In fact, the dread in her heart only grows as she gets closer to the truth...

It is not human nature to live only safely under the protection of someone powerful. Humans are different from beasts because they have a spirit of challenge, a spirit of adventure, and a free will not to be tamed. Angels and demons… Weak humanity has suffered from time immemorial due to the vicarious war of beings who can never resist. Humans in a cluster organized to escape from the pain that has been stuck like a custom set out to find a third being… The unknown being touched by many sacrifices and trial and error can rule out the interference of angels and demons. Gives you the strength that you have. To break away from good and evil, the damn dichotomy, and pioneer a new path! A new concept of exorcism action where characters with third power fight against countless demons and angels!  
  
- [Original Webtoon (Lezhin)](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/cluster)

The story is about Jung Won who lives with her mother, a florist. One day, when her mother is on an errand, a wounded boy, Ha Jun, who is her classmate suddenly enters the shop. Jung Won is a quiet and shy girl whereas Ha Jun is the popular boy. Will this night change things between them?

Reborn reincarnation. All souls are judged for their sins and are reincarnated. However, there were souls who did not accept this... 'Beom' and the shaman 'Shin-ae', one of the <Gapsa>, an exorcism extermination unit, receive the order of the Jade Hwang, and are in charge of eradicating the ghost and correcting the balance of the world. One ghost and one human... is this combination okay? The adventure story of getting rid of the bad guys! ※ 10-day serialization
description.ko: 윤회전생. 모든 영혼은 생전의 죄를 심판받고 새로이 환생한다. 그러나 이를 받아들이지 않는 영혼들이 있었으니... 원귀 퇴치부대 <갑사> 중 한 명인 '범' 과 무당 '신애'는 옥황의 명을 받아 원귀를 퇴치하고 이승의 균형을 바로잡는 일을 도맡게 된다. 한 명의 귀신과 한 명의 인간... 이 조합 괜찮을까? 좌충우돌 원귀퇴치 모험기!

description.en: The young president of the Dibicci bank, Lawrence Dibicci, controls the economic world of the Cosimo Empire. One day, a girl named Rahui is thrown under his wings instead of her father's debt.

Kang Jik-han, a righteous police officer who was demoted for reporting his colleague, arrives on an island.

While struggling between his family's safety and his stubborn sense of justice due to his continued misfortune, he encounters a suspicious secret on the island. 

Unable to turn a blind eye, Jik-han ultimately loses his beloved family to the island's residents and vows to become a monster like them, seeking greater justice against the villains who disregard the law.
description.ko:
동료를 고발한 건으로 좌천되어 한 섬에 도착하게 된 정의로운 경찰 강직한. 

지속된 불행으로 가족의 안위와 고집스런 정의사이에서 고민하고 있을 때섬의 수상한 비밀을 마주하게 된다. 

범죄 행위를 두고 볼 수 없던 직한은 결국 섬의 주민들에게 사랑하는 가족을 잃게 되고, 법따위 신경쓰지 않는 악당들에게 더욱 큰 정의를 갈구하며 그들과 똑같은 괴물이되어 복수하기를 다짐한다

description.en: Lee Soon-Hee, a very athletic girl with extraordinary acrobatic skills, lives with her older brother who is a teenage genius. Her brother is already an instructor at a university, he tends to get annoyed by his younger sister's laziness and mischievous acts. A new neighbor moves in. He is a popular, self-centered, upperclassmen pretty boy. He seems to have taken interest in her due to her unique athletic features, which changes her normal lifestyle. How will Soon-Hee's new surroundings progress to?

After being bullied and living as a reclusive loner addicted to gaming, she gains the courage through Chan, whom she met in a brilliant game. Could a disguise help her go outside? And on the day she went out in disguise for the first time, she couldn't even recognize the girl who used to torment her...?!From wigs, contact lenses, makeup, posture, to voice tone, she transforms her appearance and decides to go back to school. With this new look, she's confident! But the guy she ends up living with in a share house is so cold towards her! But... could that guy possibly...? Can she manage to keep her double life as "Bright" a secret?
description.fr: Après avoir été harcelée et avoir vécu en recluse accro aux jeux vidéo, elle trouve du courage grâce à Chan, qu'elle a rencontré dans un jeu brillant. Un déguisement pourrait-il l'aider à sortir ? Et le jour où elle est sortie déguisée pour la première fois, elle n'a même pas pu reconnaître la fille qui la tourmentait autrefois... ? ! Des perruques, des lentilles de contact, du maquillage, sa posture, au ton de sa voix, elle transforme son apparence et décide de retourner à l'école. Avec ce nouveau look, elle est confiante ! Mais le gars avec lequel elle finit par vivre dans une colocation est tellement froid avec elle ! Mais... ce gars pourrait-il peut-être...? Réussira-t-elle à garder sa double vie en tant que « Bright » secrète ?

description.en:
Based on the hit mobile game, join GingerBrave and Pure Vanilla Cookie as they ventures through Beast-Yeast with their new friends!

(Note: While the setting is the same, the storyline is completely different from the game.)

Sangbum, a misogynistic and germophobic (that is, mysophobic) plastic surgeon, is shocked to discover that the sperm he donated when he was a medical student has produced a 13-year-old daughter named Myunghae!  
  
Myunghae's other parents were killed in an accident, so she is suddenly dropped into her biological father's life. Sangbum is unprepared for the responsibility of fatherhood, but he quickly learns to love the daughter who looks so much like him.  
  
In the midst of her happy new life with Sangbum, however, Myunghae is shocked to find out that her boyfriend Hyunjoon is going out with her best friend Mijoo. The truth is that Hyunjoon and Mijoo just wanted to teach Myunghae a lesson, but unexpected feelings are growing between them. Meanwhile, a popular student named Donghui is attracted to Myunghae.   
  
With so many changes in their lives in so little time, how will the new, small family of two cope?
